items.question: How much does a French immersion stay in Bergerac cost?
items.answer: The typical one-week stay costs €1,270 one-to-one. It includes 15 hours of lessons, 3 guided outings, 3 evenings and half-board accommodation. A tailored quote is prepared according to your wishes.

items.question: Are lessons one-to-one or in a group?
items.answer: Both are possible: one-to-one lessons, or a very small group of no more than 4 people of the same level.

items.question: Can the length or programme be adjusted?
items.answer: Yes. The typical stay can be changed and adapted to your preferences — just get in touch.

items.question: Who is this French immersion homestay for?
items.answer: Adults who want to practise French intensively, combining lessons with immersion in the local culture, with personal support and some independence.

items.question: How do I get to Bergerac?
items.answer: The railway stations are a 10-minute walk from the house. In town everything is within walking or cycling distance, and the region can be explored by car or public transport.
